title: assess signals document
description: Output of skills/assess/scripts/assess_signals.py: a run stamp plus one block per scan. Generated from lib/run_context_types.py by lib/signals_schema.py.

reason.description: 'code: sentence'; a counts-only document keeps the code only. The structure block's codes name the missing piece: no_grimp, no_networkx, grimp_failed, no_python_packages (a Python repository with no importable package), no_import_graph_<language> (no import graph for the dominant source language, for example no_import_graph_rust), invalid_import_graph (a builder returned a graph that breaks the module-graph contract) and no_source_files.

ai_usage.description: Agent involvement in the commits of the run window (lib/ai_usage.py), counted from git history. An agent identity is matched by trailer (Co-Authored-By and similar) or by author against the pinned agent rules plus any [[ai_usage.agent_identities]] rules of --fleet-config. Counts are commits; shares are of total_commits. A lower bound: an agent that leaves no trace is not counted.

window.description: The history window read, for example 6mo.

since.description: The window as git --since text; dropped in counts-only output.

merge_rule.description: How merge commits are treated (excluded: not counted).

agent_trailer_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits carrying an agent trailer; null when nothing was counted.

agent_authored_commits.description: Commits whose author an agent identity matches.

agent_authored_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits whose author an agent identity matches; null when nothing was counted.

agent_either_commits.description: Commits with an agent trailer or an agent author.

agent_either_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of commits with an agent trailer or an agent author; null when nothing was counted.

dependency_bot_commits.description: Commits by a dependency-update bot (Dependabot, Renovate); never counted as agent work.

token_user_commits.description: Commits by a GitLab access-token user (project_<id>_bot_<hex>) not promoted to agent; a config rule or token_users_as_agents promotes one.

agent_identity_rule_commits.description: Commits each [[ai_usage.agent_identities]] rule matched, a positional list in rule order; the rule patterns themselves are never written.

covered_agents.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

covered_author_agents.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

limits.description: A list of strings; counts-only output keeps only its length.

ci_checks.description: Does CI run a test or lint check (lib/ci_checks.py), read from the git-tracked CI files and the GitLab includes resolved offline (lib/ci_includes.py: local files, and project or component files of clones in the --ghsync-root). test_or_lint_runs is true when an own or included CI line runs one, false when none does and every include resolved, and null (unknown) when a CI file pulls jobs from a file this run could not read (an unresolved GitLab include, a reusable workflow in another repository); basis says which.

check_commands.description: CI lines that run a test or lint check.

included_files.description: CI files that pull jobs from elsewhere.

included_check_commands.description: Lines of resolved included files that run a test or lint check.

resolved_includes.description: Include items whose every file was read.

unresolved_includes.description: Include items not read (status other than resolved).

id.description: gitlab_project:<path> or gitlab_component:<path>; null for local, template and remote.

status.description: resolved, or why not: no_root, not_cloned, file_missing, not_offline (template, remote), glob, bad_path, depth_limit, file_limit, unparsed, ref_missing (a pin the clone does not hold).

ref_basis.description: How the file was read: at the pinned ref, at the clone's HEAD (no pin), or from the work tree; null when not resolved.

depth.description: Include level: 1 for the repository's own include.

includes.description: One record per include item, nested includes after their parent; no file name or text.

test_or_lint_runs.description: The CI test-or-lint signal: true, false, or null when included jobs may hold the check.

basis.description: The reason for test_or_lint_runs: check_command (true), included_jobs (null), no_check_command or no_ci (false).

delivery.description: How work flows through review to merge (lib/delivery.py), from one shared sample of up to 30 changes merged inside the run window, newest merge first (the sample review_reality reads). A platform block: present only under --platform (absent otherwise); a refused read is available false with a reason (no_access on HTTP 403), never zeros. Durations are hours; shares are of merged_count.

merged_count.description: Merged changes in the sample (at most 30).

time_to_merge_hours_p50.description: Median time from opened to merged, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

time_to_merge_hours_p90.description: 90th percentile time from opened to merged, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

first_human_comment_hours_p50.description: Median time from opened to the first comment or review by a person other than the author (bots and agent identities excluded), in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

first_human_comment_hours_p90.description: 90th percentile time from opened to the first human comment or review, in hours (rounded to 0.01, nearest-rank percentile); null when no sampled change has both timestamps.

human_commented_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes with any human comment or review; null when nothing was counted.

ai_review_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes with a review or comment by an AI reviewer other than the author; null when nothing was counted.

approved_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes approved by someone other than the author (copied from review_reality); null when nothing was counted.

self_merged_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes merged by their author (copied from review_reality); null when nothing was counted.

agent_authored_share.description: Share (0 to 1) of changes an agent identity authored; null when nothing was counted.
